preLandingGates.reason: GitHub Issue #6: jobs terminate with steps=null before first shell step

PR #33 upgrades the active guard to V2: it consumes HOC-RC1-COMPLETED-PREFIX-STATE/V1, validates stateFingerprint/source stack, fingerprints every decision, removes the free-form completedStepIds input and binds receipts to the exact state fingerprint

stablePromotionGatesRemainSeparate: Pre-Mutation Guard V2 fingerprinted ALLOW for exact state.nextStepId
Technical Mutation Receipt SUCCESS bound to Guard V2 state fingerprint
Completed Prefix Transition for exact next step using the verified-evidence fingerprint
landingRules: Do not merge a child PR before its parent lands or the child is correctly retargeted.
Technical Execution Authorization covers only listed step IDs.
Pre-Mutation Guard V2 consumes only a fingerprint-valid Completed Prefix State; caller-supplied completedStepIds are not accepted.
Guard V2 ALLOW/DENY decisions are fingerprinted policy records, not actions.
Technical Mutation Receipt SUCCESS remains unverified until evidence verification and preserves Guard V2 state/decision fingerprints.
Mutation Evidence Verification may set eligibleForCompletedPrefix=true but never mutates state itself.
Completed Prefix Transition may advance only the logical local prefix by one exact next step; it executes no technical target mutation and persists no external state.
Operational fingerprints are tamper evidence, not digital signatures or external trust anchors.
HNK_CANON remains outside this release-operation pipeline.
